output.summary: Group ticket time rose in October 2024 at all nine locations. That matches the board's own projection (about 18 minutes) and its 19-minute ceiling. The 12-minute benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens, so it is not comparable. Guest satisfaction rose and speed scores stayed flat, so the group is not inefficient and long tickets are not eroding satisfaction. Riverside's jump to about 31 minutes began in August 2026, after the saute/pasta cook left and the post stayed unfilled, while transfer requests were deferred by group operations. The cook's reason for leaving is only hearsay, and the hours cut applied to all four line cooks under a group labor standard. Replacing the GM, par-cooked standardization and a 12-minute bonus are harmful. Restore Riverside staffing and keep the scratch menu with a group baseline.
